title: IDataSource
description:
Defines the contract for all data sources in the DotGov Framework.
Data sources provide a uniform mechanism to fetch data from various backends (databases, APIs, code providers, static options, and documents).
Implementations include Table, Api, Code, RawSql, Static, and Document data sources.

Name.description: Gets the unique name identifier for this data source. Used for references in component bindings (e.g., "ref": "pageName.dataSourceName").

Type.description:
Gets the type classification of this data source (Table, Api, RawSql, Code, Static, Document, etc.).
Determines the execution strategy and parameter handling behavior.

SingleResult.description:
Gets or sets whether this data source returns a single result object rather than a collection.
When true, the result is unwrapped from array form. When false, results are returned as a list.

ForwardPaginationParameters.description:
Gets or sets whether the component's current pagination state (page, pageSize) should be forwarded to this data source on every request.
When true, the Angular component automatically injects "page" and "pageSize" into the request — you do NOT add them to the component's Parameters list.
IMPORTANT for RawSql/StoredProcedure: when enabling this, you must also add "page" and "pageSize" entries to the data source's Parameters list
with DbType = Int32, and ensure the SQL query or stored procedure implements pagination (e.g., OFFSET (@page-1)*@pageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY).

AllowUnauthorizedAccess.description:
Gets or sets whether this data source allows unauthenticated/unauthorized access.
When true, the data source executes without requiring authentication claims.

DataSourceType.description:
Specifies the type of data source, determining how data is fetched and processed.
JSON serialized as string values. Used to classify data sources and route to appropriate executors.
